name: After § 16
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 16 a. Recalls that, pursuant to Article 2 of the EU–Israel Association Agreement, respect for human rights and democratic principles constitutes an essential element of the Agreement; expresses grave concern over repeated and serious violations of international humanitarian and human rights law; Calls on the Commission and the Council to act in accordance with Article 2 and to proceed without delay towards the suspension of the Agreement, ensuring consistency between the Union’s external action and its fundamental values;
